gaps.lead: We wanted to continue our mountain trek but the weather was too bad.
gaps.sentence: We ___ on with our mountain trek but the weather was too bad.
gaps.hint: unfulfilled wish: would have liked to
gaps.explanation: An unrealised wish about the past: 'would have liked to carry on'.

gaps.lead: My grandfather planted all these apple trees himself.
gaps.sentence: My grandfather is the ___ all these apple trees.
gaps.explanation: 'the one who…' identifies the agent with a relative clause.

gaps.lead: The garage is servicing my car tomorrow morning.
gaps.explanation: Arranged service: have/get something done — having my car serviced.

gaps.lead: He had just sat down when the phone rang.
gaps.explanation: No sooner had + subject + participle … than…

gaps.lead: We packed a spare tyre because the road might be bad.
gaps.sentence: We packed a spare tyre ___ bad.
gaps.hint: in case = because it might happen
gaps.explanation: in case + clause = as a precaution against a possibility.

gaps.lead: People believe she was the finest pianist of her generation.
gaps.sentence: She ___ the finest pianist of her generation.
gaps.explanation: A present belief about a past event: is thought to have + participle.
